messages.subject: Help with part 5 person summary
parts:
First of all, thank you so much for developing this package. It has be very helpful for my thesis. 

I’m analyzing the part 5 person summary and I will take as an example the variable “dur_day_IN_bts_240_min_wei”. According to the dictionary, it shows the “Time accumulated in bouts of 240 min inactivity during the waking time (minutes) - weighted average”. But in my data there are a lots of  subjects that shows durations below 240 minutes in that variable. I don’t know if I’m interpreting the variable wrong, but according to my logic it should show only durations that are higher than 240 minutes. I guessed that if the person does not have bouts higher than 240, it should show 0. 

Can you please tell me if I am wrong? Otherwise to go further and to see if i did something wrong in the config file.

I will upload the part 5 person summary file and the config file, just in case. 


Thanks!

messages.author: 5270e62a7d3ec577
messages.subject: Re: Help with part 5 person summary
parts:
Hi Javiera,

You are looking at the person summary, which averages the duration across all valid days included in the the daysummary file. If you look at the "part5_daysummary......" you will see that for your participants with values below 240, it's because there are days where this value was "0", so when it gets averaged the value falls below 240 and seems incorrect, but it's right. 

Thanks,
Ben
